{{For|the {{class|Hunter}} passive ability|Traps (Ability)}}
'''Traps''' are placed on a tile, occupying a unique [[Battle#Board|layer]], and inflict a specific effect on another unit that stands on that tile. They are invisible to enemies after they are placed, but can be detected by units that can see hidden things.

All traps (aside from Water Kitten Trap) have the following properties:
* Can be triggered by hitting them with physical attacks and projectiles. 
* Cats with {{Mut|legs.900}} will not trigger them.
* Trap damage is increased against units with {{st|Bruise}}, but will not crit {{st|Marked}} units.

=== Water Kitten Trap ===
Unlike all other traps, these trigger by units standing adjacent to them instead of standing on them, and can't be avoided.

Show as a generic warning tile {{RangeIndicator
|is_aoe=true
|max_range=0
|is_warn=true
}}

Spawn {{en|Water Kitten}} when a friendly unit stands adjacent to them. 
* Not triggered by small units, objects, nor units labeled as objects such as {{en|Phantom Mask}}.

Spawn naturally in the {{ch|Sewers}}.

== Trivia ==
* Despite having "Trap" in its name, {{obj|Harpoon Trap}} is just an Object with the {{p|Harpooner}} passive.
